tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Return the full Auto Lights configuration (plugin_config, zones, lighting_periods) plus a zone_indexes list. Zones are addressed by array index; lighting periods by their stable integer id.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List zones as {zone_index, name} pairs. zone_index is positional and shifts when zones are created or deleted, so re-list before acting on stale indexes.

tools.name: get_zone
tools.description: Return one zone by zone_index. Pass expected_name to fail with a conflict error if the index no longer points at that zone.

zone_index.description: Position of the zone in the zones array (from list_zones).

expected_name.description: Optional guard: the name this zone is expected to have.

tools.name: create_zone
tools.description: Append a new zone. The whole config is validated before saving; validation errors come back with precise field paths. Saving reloads the automation engine and resets all zone locks, so put the complete zone in one call.

zone.description: The zone to create. Only 'name' is required; omitted sections get engine defaults.

name.description: Zone name, used in logs and the web UI.

lighting_period_ids.description: IDs of lighting periods linked to this zone.

on_lights_dev_ids.description: Indigo device IDs turned on and off by the zone.

off_lights_dev_ids.description: Indigo device IDs the zone only turns off.

luminance_dev_ids.description: Luminance sensor device IDs; multiple are averaged.

minimum_luminance.description: Below this luminance the zone counts as dark.

minimum_luminance_use_variable.description: Take the minimum luminance from an Indigo variable instead.

minimum_luminance_var_id.description: Variable ID holding the minimum luminance.

adjust_brightness.description: Continuously scale dimmer brightness from ambient luminance.

lock_duration.description: Minutes a manual change locks the zone; -1 uses the plugin default.

extend_lock_when_active.description: Extend the lock while presence is detected.

lock_extension_duration.description: Minutes to extend the lock by; -1 uses the plugin default.

unlock_when_no_presence.description: Unlock the zone once presence clears.

enum: do not adjust unless no presence
force off unless zone is locked
off_lights_behavior.description: When to act on the off-lights list during an On-and-Off period.

exclude_from_lock_dev_ids.description: Devices whose manual changes never lock the zone.

global_behavior_variables_map.description: Per-zone enablement of global behavior variables: {"<var_id>": bool}.

tools.name: update_zone
tools.description: Partially update the zone at zone_index. Supplied section objects merge field-by-field into the existing section; scalars and arrays are replaced whole. Pass expected_name to guard against index drift. Saving resets all zone locks, so batch every change to the zone into one call.

zone_index.description: Position of the zone in the zones array (from list_zones).

zone.description: Partial zone: any subset of the create_zone zone properties.

expected_name.description: Optional guard: the name this zone is expected to have.

tools.name: delete_zone
tools.description: Delete the zone at zone_index. expected_name is REQUIRED because indexes shift; the delete fails with a conflict error if the name does not match. Later zone indexes shift down by one.

zone_index.description: Position of the zone in the zones array (from list_zones).

expected_name.description: Required guard: the exact name of the zone being deleted.

tools.name: list_lighting_periods
tools.description: List all lighting periods (stable integer ids, name, mode, time window).

tools.name: get_lighting_period
tools.description: Return one lighting period by its stable integer id.

tools.name: create_lighting_period
tools.description: Create a lighting period; the id is assigned automatically (max existing id + 1) and omitted fields get schema defaults. Saving resets all zone locks.

mode.description: On and Off: fully manage lights; Off Only: only turn lights off.

lock_duration.description: Lock-duration override in minutes for this period; -1 to disable.

limit_brightness.description: Maximum dimmer brightness during this period; -1 to disable.

tools.name: update_lighting_period
tools.description: Partially update the lighting period with the given id (supplied fields replace existing ones; the id itself is immutable). Saving resets all zone locks.

period.description: Partial period: any subset of the create_lighting_period period properties.

tools.name: delete_lighting_period
tools.description: Delete a lighting period by id. Refuses with a conflict error if any zone references it, unless force=true, which also removes the references from zones. Saving resets all zone locks.

force.description: Delete even when referenced by zones, scrubbing the references.

tools.name: update_plugin_config
tools.description: Partially update global plugin settings (supplied keys replace existing ones). Saving resets all zone locks.

default_lock_duration.description: Default zone lock duration in minutes.

global_behavior_variables.description: Variables that force all lights off when their condition matches (OR semantics).

comparison_type.description: How to compare the variable's value.

var_value.description: Value compared against for the string comparison types.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List manual and automatic config backups (newest first). An automatic backup is taken before every save.

tools.name: create_backup
tools.description: Create a manual backup of the current config and return its filename.

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Restore a backup by filename and reload the automation engine (resets all zone locks).

backup_type.description: Which backup set the file belongs to.
